kashikawa-band-density.subject: kashikawa
kashikawa-band-density.quantity: median share of a band's recorded box under a drawn crown, deep and thin

kashikawa-band-density.method: a band is drawn as clumps of one clump's size (band_clumps; a clump caps at 28 crowns), so the deep stand no longer draws sparser than the thin band (last review: 0.63 deep vs 0.83 thin); the drawn box gives up one crown radius on the house side, so the canopy edge, not the trunks, meets the band's inner edge
